summary: Royal Bank of Canada furnished a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of $1.0 billion of 5.423% Senior Fixed/Floating Rate Notes due November 5, 2030, and $1.0 billion of 5.633% Senior Fixed/Floating Rate Notes due November 5, 2032, under its $75 billion Form F-3 shelf (No. 333-275898) and the 2003 indenture with Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. Legal and tax opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell and Norton Rose Fulbright accompany the filing. This is a routine shelf takedown of senior medium-term notes, not a special situation; there are no equity terms, board recommendation, or deal mechanics to arbitrage.
